name: security-review
description: Review Entur codebases for evidence-backed security weaknesses, privacy-control gaps, misleading security claims, and AI-assisted implementation drift, with scoped STRIDE/LINDDUN output.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-based security triage with scoped STRIDE/LINDDUN output.
interface.longDescription: Performs reachability-aware security triage across application code, GCP configuration, OAuth, MCP and LLM tools, and classified-data ingestion. Scoped STRIDE/LINDDUN output adds evidence-linked data flows, privacy-control checks, coverage, and pending team hand-off. Findings require evidence and refutation; this does not replace a formal threat model or privacy assessment.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Entur AI Security Review skill to review this repository and report evidence-backed findings.
